# PUBLISHED_SECRET

A value one cluster pushed into a lab store, and where to read it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `publication`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.publication`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
